prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Chicago for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” dentist for implants — the right provider depends on your needs (single tooth vs. full-arch, need for bone grafting or sinus lift, sedation preferences, budget, timeline). I can help you find the best one for you. Here’s a quick, practical guide to choose a top implant provider in Chicago and what to ask at consults.

Who to look for
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons (OMS) — surgical experts for complex extractions, bone grafts, sinus lifts, multiple implants. Often hospital-trained.
- Periodontists — specialists in the gums and supporting bone; many place implants and handle grafting.
- Prosthodontists — specialists in restoring teeth; best for the restorative crown/bridge/denture over the implant, and full-mouth cases.
- Multi-disciplinary practices — teams with surgeon + prosthodontist together are ideal for complex or full-arch cases.

Key credentials and signals of quality
- Board certification (ABOMS for surgeons, American Board of Periodontology, American Board of Prosthodontics)
- Fellowship or advanced training in implant dentistry
- Regular use of CBCT (3D imaging) and digital planning / guided surgery
- Experience with the specific implant system you prefer (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Astra, Zimmer, etc.)
- Before/after case photos and patient references
- Positive, detailed patient reviews (not just star ratings)
- Transparent fees, treatment timeline, and complication/repair policies

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implants do you place per year? How many similar cases have you done?
- Are you board-certified or fellowship-trained in implant surgery/restorative dentistry?
- Do you do the surgery and the restoration, or will another specialist handle restoration?
- Do you use CBCT and digital planning/guided implants?
- What implant system and materials do you use? Do you offer immediate/teeth-in-a-day options?
- What is the full estimated cost (surgery, implant, abutment, crown, grafting) and timeline?
- What are the risks and your implant failure rate?
- Can I see before/after photos and patient testimonials?
- What is included in follow-up care and warranties?

Where to search locally
- American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (AAOMS) find-a-surgeon and American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID) directories
- Illinois State Dental Society listings
- University of Illinois at Chicago College of Dentistry — teaching faculty clinics can be high quality and more affordable
- Review sites: Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Google Reviews — read written reviews for details

If you want, I can:
- Find top-rated implant specialists in a specific Chicago neighborhood (e.g., Loop, Lincoln Park, Near North, suburbs) — tell me where you are or any preferences (insurance, price range, urgent timeline).
- Prepare a short script of questions to use on the phone or at the consult.

Which neighborhood or type of implant case are you looking for?
